instruction: Fix `linked_list_append` so it walks only as far as the last node (the current loop walks past the tail and crashes).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/ds.py b/ds.py
--- a/ds.py
+++ b/ds.py
@@ -29,7 +29,7 @@
     if head is None:
         return new
     cur = head
-    while cur is not None:
+    while cur.next is not None:
         cur = cur.next
     cur.next = new
     return head
